entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-31
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Perf regression: updates #64223
  • FromQueryAttribute with Dictionary incorrectly handles missing parameters #64222
  • [Blazor] Different component rendering logic could be observed between .NET 9 and .NET 10 #64221
  • Blazor WebAsm + bootstrap rendering issue if part of the table is generated dynamically. #64217
    Backlog
  • Roadmap: First-class Web Components support for Razor components (or endorse JS Render API + helpers) #64216
    Backlog
  • TempData could not be loaded if the cookie values were enclosed in double quotes #64215

Closed

  • Api #64224
  • ResponseCompression tests should verify functionality, not exact compressed byte counts #63969
  • Inconsistency in customized built-in custom elements (webcomponents) support #64213
  • Error list contains an error warnings "The current Visual Studio version does not support targeting .NET 10.0. Either target .NET 99.9 or lower..." after opening the dogfooding solution #63984
  • VS 2026 Blazor MSAL Login Loop #64032

PullRequests

Created

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #64214
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops
